techniques.effect: 摄影机后退，逐步揭开环境信息
techniques.observation: 先看摄影机是否真的移动，再看主体大小、背景视差与运动方向。
techniques.examplePromptZh: 从一名神情平静的钢琴家面部紧特写开始。摄影机以固定焦距，在一个连续镜头中向后移动，逐步揭示三角钢琴独自立在一间被水淹没的舞厅里。保持面部自然，直到镜头中段才显露积水。
techniques.examplePromptEn: Start tightly on a calm pianist’s face. Pull the camera backward in one uninterrupted shot, fixed focal length, gradually revealing that the grand piano stands alone in a flooded ballroom. Keep the face natural and delay the water reveal until the middle of the shot.

techniques.effect: 从人物身后同步移动，跟随前行
techniques.observation: 先看摄影机是否真的移动，再看主体大小、背景视差与运动方向。
techniques.examplePromptZh: 摄影机从【主体】身后跟拍，配合其穿行空间的移动速度。
techniques.examplePromptEn: The camera follows behind [Subject], matching their movement through the space.

techniques.effect: 紧贴局部细节，呈现细微表情变化
techniques.observation: 观察人物占据多少画面、保留多少环境，以及前后主体如何组织。
techniques.examplePromptZh: 拍摄一名年长女钟表匠眼部的大特写，她正在决定是否打开一个密封的机械装置。取景从眉部到上脸颊，保留自然皮肤纹理，眼神只有细小变化，呼吸克制。光线收敛，对焦稳定，不做磨皮美化，不出现广角导致的面部畸变。
techniques.examplePromptEn: Extreme close-up of an older watchmaker’s eyes as she decides whether to open a sealed mechanism. Frame from brow to upper cheek, natural skin texture, tiny shift in gaze and controlled breathing. Restrained light, stable focus, no cosmetic smoothing or wide-angle facial distortion.

techniques.effect: 同时呈现两人表情，借距离变化传情
techniques.observation: 观察人物占据多少画面、保留多少环境，以及前后主体如何组织。
techniques.examplePromptZh: 保持一个侧面中景双人镜头：两名昔日的商业伙伴隔着咖啡馆一张狭窄的桌子相对而坐。两人的面部始终同时清晰可读。一个人向前倾，另一个人缓慢向后靠。不切到单人镜头，不改变焦点，通过两人距离的变化表达紧张关系。
techniques.examplePromptEn: Hold a medium profile two-shot of two former business partners seated across a narrow café table. Both faces remain readable at once. One leans forward while the other slowly leans back. No cutting to singles, no focus change, tension expressed through changing distance.

techniques.effect: 切近关键物件，补充推动情节的细节
techniques.observation: 观察人物占据多少画面、保留多少环境，以及前后主体如何组织。
techniques.examplePromptZh: 围绕一个未拆封的蓝色信封，构思一段短小的盗骗故事，三个陌生人都在寻找它。始终不揭示信封内容。围绕不断变化的信任、误拿信封，以及一名角色选择朋友而放弃信封来组织场景。为每个镜头生成外观一致、容易追踪辨认的道具。
techniques.examplePromptEn: Outline a short caper around an unopened blue envelope sought by three strangers. Never reveal its contents. Build the scenes around shifting trust, mistaken possession and one character choosing a friend over the envelope. Generate a consistent, easily trackable prop for every shot.

cases.title: 让故事，继续

Make one gentle brush pass from the left end of this spine section to the right and stop. Do not brush the cover or move back and forth. Keep the contact point in focus.

shotReviews.title: 磨损处
shotReviews.targetEffect: 旧书平放在修复台上，书脊朝向镜头。一只手用柔软小刷沿磨损书脊轻轻刷过一次，露出纸纤维；不出现修复前后瞬间变化。

designPrompt.zh:
目标剪辑时长 4 秒，画幅 16:9。单个连续镜头。
同一本靛蓝布面旧书，封面右下角有一小块浅米色补布，尺寸与布纹跨镜一致。开场书脊磨损，末尾修补后仍保留使用痕迹。修复者穿亚麻袖衣，读者是灰色毛衣袖口；不拍脸。木质工作台、左侧晨光，平实低饱和色彩。
旧书平放在修复台上，书脊朝向镜头。一只手用柔软小刷沿磨损书脊轻轻刷过一次，露出纸纤维；不出现修复前后瞬间变化。
与书脊接近等高的斜侧微距，保留刷头与书脊接触处的景深。
摄影机保持固定。
书脊横向占画面中段，手从左侧进入；背景自然虚化。
左侧窗户漫射晨光，纸纤维柔和可见，不做强烈光束。
磨损书脊上的纸纤维与刷头接触点；接触区清楚，远处逐渐失焦。
声音设计：轻微刷毛摩擦声与安静室内底噪，无旁白。
保留旧物痕迹，动作克制且接触真实；不做魔法修复、纸张淋雨、森林倒影、奢侈品陈列、圆形转场、环绕或夸张粒子。
不生成叠加字幕、片名或标志；片名后期制作。音轨和时长按目标工具能力另行设置。
designPrompt.en:
Target edit duration 4 seconds, aspect ratio 16:9. One continuous shot.
The same indigo clothbound old book has a small pale-beige repair patch on the lower-right cover corner; its size and cloth texture remain consistent. The opening spine is frayed; repaired areas still retain signs of use at the end. The restorer wears linen sleeves, the reader gray wool cuffs; faces stay outside frame. A wooden worktable, morning light from the left, restrained natural colors.
The old book rests on the repair table with its spine facing camera. One hand makes a single gentle pass with a soft small brush along the frayed spine, revealing paper fibers; no instant before-and-after transformation.
Oblique side macro near spine level, with enough depth of field to read the brush-to-spine contact.
Keep the camera locked off.
The spine crosses the middle of frame; the hand enters from the left; the background falls gently out of focus.
Soft morning window light from the left reveals paper fibers without a pronounced beam.
Paper fibers and the brush contact point on the frayed spine; keep the contact zone crisp with gradual falloff beyond it.
Sound design: A faint brush sound over quiet room tone, no voice-over.
Retain signs of use, restrained actions and plausible contact. No magical repair, rain on paper, forest reflections, luxury-product staging, circular match cuts, orbiting camera or exaggerated particles.
No overlaid captions, titles or logos; add titles in post-production. Set audio and duration separately according to the target tool.

actualInput.en: 5 seconds, 16:9. Oblique side macro near spine level. The book starts closed and lying flat, frayed spine toward camera. A hand in a plain linen sleeve gently makes ONE slow pass with a small soft brush across the worn spine, then pauses. Show realistic fine paper fibers; keep the brush-to-spine contact zone crisp with enough depth of field, background softly out of focus. The hand enters from the left. The spine crosses the middle of frame. No sudden repair or change of material. Soft diffuse window light, no pronounced light shaft. The same small old indigo clothbound book, a small pale-beige rectangular repair patch at the lower-right corner of the front cover, naturally yellowed paper and signs of use. The reference image defines book identity and workshop materials, not mandatory framing or closed-book pose. An ordinary wooden repair table, soft morning light from a window on the left, restrained natural colors. No faces, no speech, no music, no overlaid text or logos. Quiet workshop room tone and subtle contact sounds only. No rain, mirrors, forest imagery, magical transformation or exaggerated particles. Keep the camera locked off: no zoom, pan, orbit or cuts within the clip. Plausible hands, rigid book geometry and continuous physical contact.
actualInput.translationZh: 5 秒，16:9。接近书脊高度的斜侧微距。开场旧书合上平放，磨损书脊朝镜头。穿素色亚麻袖衣的手用小软刷缓慢轻刷书脊一次，然后停住。纸纤维真实细小，刷头与书脊接触区清楚，景深足以看清接触，背景柔和虚化。手从左侧进入，书脊横向穿过画面中段。不要突然修好或改变材料。柔和漫射窗光，不做明显光束。同一本小型靛蓝布面旧书，前封面右下角有小块浅米色矩形补布，纸边自然泛黄并保留旧痕。参考图只规定书的身份与工作台材质，不强制沿用构图或合书姿态。普通木质修复台，左侧窗户柔和晨光，色彩自然克制。不拍脸，无人声、音乐、叠加文字或标志；只有安静工作室底噪和轻微接触声。不要雨、镜面、森林意象、魔法变化或夸张粒子。摄影机固定：镜内不变焦、摇移、环绕或切镜。手部合理，书的几何稳定，接触连续。

shotReviews.intent: 用一次针线劳动，让照料成为可见动作，而非瞬间修复。
shotReviews.selectionReason: 微距应读清针尖、线与已有装订孔的接触；将动作缩为一次穿孔，避免塞入完整修书流程。
shotReviews.observedEffect: 约 0–4 秒针靠近并下移到纸页上的点位，约 5–9 秒手提针线；亚麻袖口、旧纸和工作台可见，动作集中在一次下移与提线。
problems: 打开的书页与独立书壳看起来叠在一册合上的靛蓝旧书上，出现重复对象 / 结构不一致，不能确认是同一本书的正常打开状态。
本方案要求针穿书脊既有装订孔，实际针尖却落在打开页片偏外侧的点位，与目标作用位置不符；不能以出现针线和上下动作就判为装订成立。
画面仍含完整手和较大书体，没有达到针尖—孔—线的极近微距尺度。
shotReviews.causeAssessment: 原身份图是合书状态，文字要求改成开书和穿针；本次输出同时保留合书身份并添加开书结构。这是可见偏差与可能相关的输入条件，不是已证实原因。

nextAttempt.action: 先画清单一书体与书脊装订孔的位置关系，准备孔位可辨的起始参考；只测试同一孔上的一次穿针，先验收作用位置和书体结构，再考虑微距效果。
nextAttempt.promptRole: 候选对象数量、起始状态与接触约束，必须配合新的真实输入参考，不当作本轮历史输入。
nextAttempt.promptZh: 画面中只有一本书，其已打开的书帖位于软书托上，下面没有合上的第二本书或额外书壳。近距构图显示书脊处一个已存在的装订孔，针尖在孔的入口外，单根线与针相连。只完成从该入口穿过到另一侧的一个动作；孔、纸与手的相对位置保持稳定。
nextAttempt.promptEn: Show exactly one book, its open section supported on a soft cradle, with no second closed book or extra cover underneath. A tight view shows one existing binding hole at the spine. The needle tip begins just outside its entrance, attached to one continuous thread. Perform only one pass through that entrance to the other side, keeping hole, paper and hand positions stable.
nextAttempt.check: 先核对书体数量、书脊、目标孔与针的相对位置；再逐帧核对入口、出口和线的连续性。这里检验本方案的空间关系，不把候选描述当作专业修复工艺证明。

logicReview.label: 动作逻辑未通过
logicReview.expected: 按本方案预设，针应作用于同一本书书脊处既有装订孔；入口、出口与线的走向要能对应。不是泛化断言所有书籍装订都使用同一工艺。
logicReview.observed: 针尖落在页片上的点位，打开的页块与下方合书形成疑似叠书结构，目标修复部位和书体关系没有成立。
logicReview.check: 先确认只有一个书体、书脊和目标孔，再检查针入口—出口—线是否围绕同一孔连续，最后检查动作是否真的改变目标部位。

designPrompt.en:

logicReview.expected: 按本方案预设，针应作用于同一本书书脊处既有装订孔；入口、出口与线的走向要能对应。不是泛化断言所有书籍装订都使用同一工艺。

logicReview.check: 先确认只有一个书体、书脊和目标孔，再检查针入口—出口—线是否围绕同一孔连续，最后检查动作是否真的改变目标部位。

actualInput.en: 10 seconds, 16:9, one continuous locked close-up. Use the provided FIRST and LAST frames as the exact start and end states of ONE slow needle INSERTION, not a whole repair process. There is ONE open book on a linen cradle, not an open book stacked on a closed book. Identify the existing hole at the central paper FOLD/GUTTER on the spine line, immediately under the needle tip in the first frame. Keep that very hole fixed. Pause briefly, then move the same single needle point-first gradually deeper into that SAME existing center-fold hole, until about half the visible shaft has disappeared through it as in the last frame. Only one small insertion, then a quiet hold. Keep the visible thread connected to the same needle eye and following naturally. Do not pull a needle out elsewhere, create a new hole, sew through a page fore-edge, pierce fingers, repeat the stitch or pretend to finish the book. The underside and needle exit may remain occluded; do not invent a second exposed book. The left hand steadies the same paper section, the right thumb and forefinger follow the needle; keep the contact zone visible. Paper folds, existing stitches, covers and book count remain stable. Same aged indigo cloth, yellowed paper, linen sleeves, wooden worktable and soft morning light from the left. Camera and focus fixed, sufficient depth of field at hole and needle; no zoom, cuts, orbit, magic, particles, labels or text. No voices or music, only quiet workshop room tone and very soft contact sound.
actualInput.translationZh: 10 秒，16:9，一个连续固定近景。用所给首帧与尾帧规定一次缓慢插针的起止状态，不演完整修书流程。只有一本打开并支在亚麻书托上的书，不是在合上的书上叠一本打开的书。目标是首帧针尖正下方、沿书脊线的纸张中央折缝／书沟上的既有孔；该孔位置固定。短暂停顿后，同一根针尖朝前缓慢深入同一个中央折缝孔，直到约一半可见针杆进入孔中，达到尾帧状态。只做一次小幅插入，再安静停留。可见线始终连在同一个针眼并自然跟随。不从别处抽出针，不造新孔，不穿纸张外沿，不扎手，不重复穿针，不假装完成整本书。下侧与出针点可以被遮挡，不凭空生成第二本暴露的书。左手稳住同一书帖，右手拇指和食指随针移动，接触区保持可见。纸折、既有针脚、封面与书的数量稳定。延续靛蓝旧布面、泛黄纸、亚麻袖口、木台与左侧柔和晨光。机位与焦点固定，孔和针附近景深充分；不变焦、切镜、环绕、魔法、粒子、标签或文字。无人声、无音乐，仅安静工作室底噪与很轻的接触声。

shots.title: 合书方向
shots.assessmentLabel: 同一书脊合拢可读 · 小角度动作
shots.change: 首帧只让前封面略微抬起，页块与后封面已经平放；左手稳书脊，右手沿自由边绕同一左侧长书脊放下，尾帧明确同一封面闭合状态。保留柔和窗光，暂不追求强化光束。
shots.observedEffect: 原片约 0.1–1 秒前封面保持小角度抬起，约 1–3 秒右手随封面自由边下落，左侧长书脊与页块基本留在原位；约 3 秒后封面落平并停留。补布一直随同一前封面移动，没有首版从远侧短边竖起再翻合的明显轴关系矛盾。
problems: 起始动作从完全展开缩小为仅前封面略抬，不是首版整段展开动作的同幅度复现。
未量测精确旋转角度或逐点刚体误差；只作本段方向与连接关系的定性判断。
本轮不再强化体积光，不能用本镜证明该灯光规则已达标；跨镜布面磨损与补布形状仍有细节差异。
shots.check: 追踪同一左侧长书脊、移动封面、右侧自由边和补布；固定页块不被翻起，封面只绕同一长边下降，右手接触随动。最后合上不能代替中间轴关系检查。

evidenceFrames.caption: 返修原片 0.10 秒 / 新成片 10.10 秒：左侧书脊固定，右侧自由边抬起。
返修原片 1.75 秒 / 新成片 11.75 秒：右手沿自由边下放，补布随封面移动。
返修原片 3.50 秒 / 新成片 13.50 秒：同一封面落平，页块留在台面。

logicReview.check: 对照展开、半合、合拢三帧，追踪同一书脊、封面连接边、自由边和补布；核对旋转轴、手施力方向与最终封面朝向能否连续解释。

actualInput.en: 5 seconds, 16:9. Animate ONE gentle book closure between these first and last frames. At the start the front cover alone is slightly raised. The left LONG SPINE is the single fixed hinge: keep it and the back cover and the entire yellowed page block stationary on the wooden table. The right hand maintains gentle fingertip contact with the raised front cover's RIGHT FREE EDGE and slowly lowers that rigid cover about the LEFT LONG SPINE HINGE, through one continuous small arc, until it lies flat on the page block by about 3 seconds; hold for the remaining time. The left hand stays at the spine to steady the book. The small beige patch travels WITH THE SAME FRONT COVER and remains at its lower-right outer corner. Never pivot at a short edge, lift the page block, turn a paper leaf into a cover, flip the whole book, detach the hinge or add a second book. Keep geometry and hand contact continuously readable, no extra gesture. Preserve the same aged indigo cloth, patch, linen sleeves, tabletop, soft left window light and restrained colors. Fixed camera and focus, no cuts, zoom, orbit, exaggerated light beam, dust, magic, text or logos. Quiet workshop room tone and a subtle cloth-cover contact sound, no speech or music.
actualInput.translationZh: 5 秒，16:9。在首尾帧之间只做一次轻柔合书。开始时只有前封面略微抬起。左侧长书脊是唯一固定转轴：它、后封面与整块泛黄书页都固定在木台上。右手指尖持续轻触抬起前封面的右侧自由边，绕左侧长书脊连接轴沿一条连续小圆弧缓慢放下这一块硬封面，约 3 秒时平放到页块上，余下时间停住。左手留在书脊处稳住书。小块米色补布随同一前封面移动，始终位于其外侧右下角。不得绕短边旋转、抬起页块、把纸页变成封面、翻转整本书、断开连接轴或增加第二本书。书体与手部接触全过程可读，不加额外手势。保留靛蓝旧布面、补布、亚麻袖口、台面、左侧柔和窗光和克制色彩。机位和焦点固定，不切镜、变焦、环绕、夸张光束、纸尘、魔法、文字或标志。只有安静工作室底噪和轻微布面合拢接触声，无人声和音乐。

lessons: 先把对象结构与动作起止状态做对，再叠加镜头语言：本轮专用参考中先确定单一书体、中缝孔、固定页块和移动封面。它们与身份图承担不同任务。
开合类动作以物体自身的连接轴定义路径，同时追踪自由边与识别标记；画面左／右只能辅助描述，不能代替连接关系。该检查可迁移到盒盖、门、机械开合等新题材。
把复杂动作缩成一个清楚阶段，有助于这次画面表达：一针只推进同一孔，合书只从略抬到落平。代价是不能宣称展示了完整工艺或大幅度开合。
首尾图片正确仍需检查中间帧。验收作用点、接触、路径和终态；未看见针的出口与完整拉线，就单独保留验证缺口。
保留首版失败与局部返修的准确输入、参考、素材和剪辑范围；此次多项改动共同进行，只能记录局部改善，不能推导通用成功率或单一方法的因果结论。
limits: 仍为香水、旧书两个题材；旧书为一次四镜首版加一次两镜局部返修，不新增第三个题材，也不把两镜算两个独立重复实验。
参考图、构图、动作范围、首尾约束和提示词同时变化，不是单变量实验，未测试其他模型或重复稳定性。
仅判断这两段可见入口位置与合书轴改善；完整装订工艺、精确运动几何和受众情绪未验证。
声音仅检查音轨存在和解码，未听评内容、接触同步或音色；不宣称音频内容达标。
刷拭与交还的原始文件及取材起止保持一致；最终成片重新编码与整片响度处理，不宣称输出逐像素或音频采样锁定。

The right hand holds the same cup HANDLE continuously, left palm supports the BASE from below, cup upright in front of lower chest, tea not spilling. Continue for TWO short natural steps toward the same window over roughly the first three seconds, then settle with both feet planted and pause for the final two seconds. Stop before the wall/window at a comfortable distance. No drinking, lifting cup to face, backward steps, turning to camera, extra gesture, sliding feet or duplicate cup. Follow smoothly from behind at a gentle rear-three-quarter angle, advancing in the person's direction at roughly matching speed, then stop the camera when the person stops. Keep the person screen right and at roughly constant readable size; show legs and ground contacts where possible. The window remains ahead/left, the worn wooden table stays left, and cabinet stays right. Preserve real perspective change and foreground parallax as the camera advances: no zoom, orbit, room mirroring, object drift or moving the window to fake travel. Keep the same daylight, knit and ivory glaze; no dramatic grading or hurried pursuit. Let a clear destination and an unforced stop express the choice to take a moment. One continuous shot, no cut, generated text, logo, tears or exaggerated acting. Soft footsteps, fabric rustle and continuous quiet room tone only; no speech or music.
actualInput.translationZh: 5 秒，16:9。图 1 是同一人物、杯子、房间与端杯步态开始时的后方构图参考。图 2 只提供放松停步和双脚落地的姿态，不锁定它的背景机位，也不把整幅图变形过渡到该图。保持同一短发成人、深灰针织衣、深色裤子与拖鞋，背向镜头不露脸。右手持续握同一杯柄，左掌从下托住杯底；杯子直立放在身体前方下胸位置，茶水不洒。约前三秒继续朝同一扇窗自然走两个短步，然后双脚落地站稳，最后两秒停留。在窗／墙前的舒适距离停住。不喝茶、不举杯到脸前、不倒退、不转身看镜头、不加手势、不滑步、不增加杯子。摄影机从轻微后方三分之四角度平稳跟随，大致匹配人物速度向前，在人物停步时也停下。人物保持画面偏右和大致稳定的可辨大小，尽量看清腿与脚接地。窗户仍在前方／左侧，旧木桌在左，柜子在右。摄影机前进应有真实透视和前景视差，不变焦、环绕、镜像房间、漂移物体或移动窗户来假装行走。延续日光、针织和米白陶面，不加戏剧调色或追逐感。让明确目的地和自然停步表达主动留出片刻的选择。单一连续镜头，不切镜、不生成文字或标志，不哭泣或夸张表演。只有轻脚步、衣料声和连续安静室内底噪，无人声和音乐。

shotReviews.intent: 人物已经停步，通过空间展开和最后两秒静止，加深为自己停留的感受。
shotReviews.selectionReason: 后拉把局部的杯子／背影放回同一日常空间，同时保留人的在场；本应由主体不动和相机退后来分工。
shotReviews.observedEffect: 画面确实从近景向宽景展开，但人物在后拉过程中重新迈步；约2.75–4.0秒可见脚底抬起与落下，直到约4.5秒后才接近双脚落稳。相机也持续后退到末段，没有实现3秒完成后拉、2秒静止的安排。
problems: 上一镜已停，下一镜又走，违反“已经停住”的起始状态，打断跨镜动作与情绪逻辑。
同时出现主体前行和相机后退；不能只凭画面变宽判定“人停住、相机后拉”已实现。

shotReviews.causeAssessment: 两个首尾构图都呈现托杯姿态，但不保证中间过程保持停住。近远参考的站位和透视变化可能被模型解释成继续走向窗户；这只是原因假设，不能从单次样本确定。

designPrompt.zh:
目标剪辑 5 秒，16:9。
同一只米白陶瓷杯，略带细小斑点，杯柄根部有一个蓝色小点，杯中茶水不满。人物一直穿深灰针织衣，背向镜头，不露脸。普通木桌与同一扇窗，左侧柔和白天窗光，窗外只有静止绿意。
让已停步的人与日常空间共同承担安静的余味，保留人的在场感。
人物仍在同一窗前，双手持同一杯子，背向镜头，身体已停止移动。
人物保持稳定托杯，只允许自然细微呼吸，整个镜头不再走动或额外摆姿势。
人物与杯子仍留在同一窗前，环境已被看见，动作状态保持。
一人一杯保持身份和支撑关系，窗户与木桌的方位承接上一镜，摄影机后退不带动物体漂移。
从杯子与背影的近景缓慢向后拉轨，焦距保持固定，约前三秒揭示窗边与木桌，随后机位停住。
人物仍清楚可辨，普通茶室逐渐进入画面，保留适量空间而不让人缩成孤点。
延续同一柔和左侧窗光，室内暗部保留层次，窗外绿意不过曝。
约三秒后停止拉轨，留两秒静止余味，末尾后期轻淡出。
计划保留连续室内底噪，动作声减少后仍有空间感，片尾自然收声。
保持一杯一人、杯柄和蓝点一致，手与杯子的支撑关系合理，茶水不洒。不加哭泣、夸张表演、漂浮物、品牌字或奢侈品展台。
不生成叠加片名或字幕；后期排字。实际生成时长、参考图和音轨另行设置。
designPrompt.en:
Target edit: 5 seconds, 16:9.
The same speckled ivory ceramic cup has one small blue dot at the handle base and is partly filled with tea. The person wears the same dark-gray knit top, remains back to camera, and shows no face. Keep the ordinary wooden table and same window, soft daylight from the left, and still greenery outside.
Let the paused person and ordinary room support a quiet aftertaste while retaining a clear sense of human presence.
The person remains at the same window, holding the same cup in both hands, back to camera and already still.
Maintain the supported cup with only subtle natural breathing, without further walking or extra posing.
The person and cup remain at the same window as the room has been revealed, with the held state unchanged.
Maintain one person and one cup, consistent identity and support, and the previous window/table layout. Camera retreat must not make objects drift.
Dolly backward slowly from a close view of the cup and back at a fixed focal length, revealing the window corner and table over roughly three seconds, then hold the camera still.
Keep the person clearly readable as the ordinary tea room enters frame, allowing space without reducing the figure to an isolated speck.
Continue the same soft left window light, preserving interior shadow detail and exterior greenery.
Finish the dolly around three seconds, hold for a two-second aftertaste, and add a gentle ending fade in post.
Plan continuous room tone that retains a sense of space after action sounds diminish, with a natural audio ending.
Keep one cup and one person, consistent handle and blue dot, plausible hand support, and no spilled tea. No crying, exaggerated acting, floating objects, brand lettering or luxury display pedestal.
No generated overlay titles or captions; add text in post. Configure actual generation duration, references and audio separately.

actualInput.en: 5 seconds, 16:9. Use the supplied close window-pause image as the FIRST FRAME and wider room view as the END FRAME. The same person has ALREADY STOPPED at the window. Keep that person and the single speckled ivory cup stationary in the room for the entire shot, with only subtle natural breathing. Right hand stays on the handle and left palm supports the base; the tea stays level. Keep the one blue dot at the lower handle attachment; if the grip hides it, leave it hidden instead of inventing a mark on the cup front. NO additional steps, drinking, cup raising, head turn, slumping or new gesture. Move ONLY the CAMERA backward on a smooth dolly at a FIXED FOCAL LENGTH during roughly seconds 0–3, revealing more of the same window corner, wooden table at foreground left, floor and cabinet at right. Then LOCK the camera and hold the wider view for roughly seconds 3–5. Preserve coherent perspective/parallax and room geography; do not zoom, orbit, warp furniture, shrink the person's body in place or move the window to imitate a dolly. Keep a readable human presence, relaxed upright body and ordinary lived-in room rather than an isolated tiny silhouette. Maintain the same window daylight and exterior green leaves, with restrained texture and detail in interior shadows. This chosen pause and the held final view should support quiet personal time, without asking for sad acting. One continuous shot, no cuts, fake text, logo, magical particles or new objects. Continuous quiet room tone and slight clothing sound only, no speech or music. Do not generate a title or fade; those are added in editing if needed.
actualInput.translationZh: 5 秒，16:9。所给窗边停留近景为首帧，较宽房间画面为尾帧。同一人物已经在窗前停稳，全镜中人物与同一只米白斑点陶杯在房间里保持不动，只保留自然细微呼吸。右手持续持柄，左掌托底，茶水保持水平。把手下连接处只有一个蓝点；被手遮住就自然遮挡，不在杯身正面凭空补标记。不再走步、喝茶、举杯、转头、垂头或加手势。约 0–3 秒只让摄影机以固定焦距平稳后退，逐步露出同一窗边、左前景木桌、地板和右侧柜子；约 3–5 秒机位固定，保持宽景。维持连贯的透视、视差和房间方位，不变焦、环绕、扭曲家具、让人物原地缩小或移动窗户来假装后拉。人物仍清楚可辨、姿态放松直立，房间仍有日常生活感，不缩成孤立的小剪影。延续窗户日光与窗外绿叶，质感克制，室内暗部保留细节。通过主动停留与最终保持的画面，表达属于自己的安静时间，不要求悲伤表演。单一连续镜头，不切镜，不加假文字、标志、魔法粒子或新物体。只有连续安静室内底噪和少量衣料声，无人声和音乐。不要生成片名或淡出，需要时在后期完成。

reusePatterns.title: 把情绪要求落实为可以观察的动作和持时
reusePatterns.whenToUse: 安静、犹豫、释然等需要观众经历一段停顿的短片。
reusePatterns.retain: 明确谁停止什么动作、从哪一刻开始、持续多久；逐项对照实际视频。
reusePatterns.adapt: 换成放下工具、停在门口、看向对方等新的情境，按关系重新说明停顿的意义。
reusePatterns.limit: 本轮停步和停镜未完全协同；这是实际偏差推导的检查方法，不是已经验证的情绪成功配方。

reusePatterns.title: 人物停止与摄影机停止分别验收
reusePatterns.whenToUse: 人物行走、跟拍、后拉和静止余味同时出现。
reusePatterns.retain: 分别追踪脚底／道具与环境的关系，以及背景在相机中的变化。
reusePatterns.adapt: 可换成车停、放下器物后运镜等场景，重新定义固定物和移动物。
reusePatterns.limit: 本轮看到人停而镜头继续，以及后拉时人物也走；未量测三维轨迹，也没有证明新提示词能修正。

reusePatterns.title: 首尾参考与过程约束是两件事
reusePatterns.whenToUse: 同一物体在首尾都看似正确，但中间过程决定内容逻辑。
reusePatterns.retain: 首尾之外还检查接触、脚步和中间状态，不以终点合理代替全过程正确。
reusePatterns.adapt: 适用于走停、拿放、开合、接递等动作；参考图需按本次物体关系设计。
reusePatterns.limit: 本次首尾托杯仍出现额外行走；单张首帧的候选改法尚未生成。

reusePatterns.title: 提交失败、生成完成和表达达标分别记录
reusePatterns.whenToUse: 创作中遇到服务报错、改参考方式或素材生成后仍偏离动作与情绪。
reusePatterns.retain: 保留失败原输入、批准范围、每次实际输入与结果；完成任务后继续按动作和表达审片。
reusePatterns.adapt: 新题材按需要改素材和指令，重试或换模式先说明具体变化与费用，不把无任务号错误推断成特定原因。
reusePatterns.limit: 本轮两次首尾帧提交未获任务号，改模式和简化文本后成功；两项同时变化，不证明模式本身解决了错误。完成的后拉镜头仍未达动作任务。

workflow: 先读目标感受、情境意义和另一种可能解读。
把行动前后状态、接触关系、主体停止、相机停止与持时分别列出。
按目标检索技巧和真实经验；读本案例逐镜动作与表达判断及边界。
改写主体、关系、场景和镜头，不照抄陶杯、窗景或暖木色。
保存准确提交输入与参考角色，实际生成后检查中间帧和完整成片。
分开保存模型判断、观众感受和未执行候选；不要把暖光、静态图或终点姿态当作情绪验证。

brief.goal: 为社区修车摊做一支短片，让通勤者记住这里不止修好车，也会认真照应来取车的人。
brief.subject: 一位下班来取车的通勤者、一位修车人、一辆已完成维修的城市自行车。
brief.audience: 日常骑车通勤、愿意选择附近小店的人。
brief.feeling: 从带着一天疲惫的等待，走向被认真照应后的安心，再从容继续回家的路。
brief.avoidFeeling: 煽情救赎、怜悯、夸张神修、速度炫技或孤独的空镜。
brief.setting: 普通社区修车摊，雨已停的傍晚。表现取车与交接，不演示完整维修，也不声称几秒钟修好。
brief.assets: 尚无人物、自行车或店面参考图；身份图与交接起止构图需在制作前准备。

title.en: A Little Help Along the Way

concept.zh: 用一次取车，把“认真照应”变成行动：看见来人、擦干座垫、扶稳交接、目送离开。车在开场前已修好；我们拍服务发生的关系，不把机械奇迹或暖色滤镜当作安心的原因。
concept.en: Make attentive care visible through a bicycle pickup: acknowledge the visitor, dry the saddle, steady the handover, and let them leave. The repair is already complete before the opening; care comes from an exchange, not a mechanical miracle or a warm filter.

anchor.zh: 同一普通社区修车摊，门内工作台在画面左后，门外人行道延伸向画面右侧，雨后阴天傍晚的柔和自然光。同一短发成年通勤者穿深蓝薄外套、卡其长裤、斜挎帆布包；同一修车人穿灰色工装与褪色棕围裙。只有同一辆无标志深绿色低跨城市自行车：黑座垫、银色车把、两只相同车轮。车头朝出门方向，几何、两人服装和光线保持一致。
anchor.en: The same ordinary neighborhood repair stall: workbench at back left and pavement extending to screen right, under soft overcast evening light after rain. The same short-haired adult commuter wears a navy jacket, khaki trousers and canvas crossbody bag. The same mechanic wears gray work clothes and a faded brown apron. Exactly one unbranded dark-green step-through city bicycle with a black saddle, silver handlebar and two consistent wheels. Its front points toward the exit. Keep bicycle geometry, clothing and light consistent.

constraints.zh: 写实、克制、正常速度。不演示完整维修、不瞬间改变车况、不骑上车、不添加交通冲突；无额外人物、复制车轮、悬空车身或手穿过车把。手离开之前必须已有另一只手扶稳。无品牌字、生成字幕或片名，文字若需要在后期加入。
constraints.en: Restrained realism at normal speed. Do not depict an entire repair or an instant change in condition; no mounting or riding, traffic conflict, extra people, duplicated wheels, floating bicycle or hands through metal. Another hand must already steady the bicycle before support is released. No logos or generated captions or titles; add any text in post.

emotion.viewerExperience: 希望看到的不是一个被拯救的人，而是疲惫的日常被另一人认真接住一下。
emotion.opening: 来取车的人还带着工作日的疲惫，站在门边等待。
emotion.event: 修车人注意到来人，先擦干座垫，再扶稳车身等待对方接稳。
emotion.ending: 被照应后的安心，落实为自己稳稳推车继续走，而不是夸张感激。
emotion.contextReason: 安心有具体原因：对方主动做了一点额外照料，且把支撑完整交给我。我重新接回自己的行动能力。

creativeDirection.audience: 日常骑车通勤、愿意选择附近小店的人。
creativeDirection.viewingContext: 暂定用于小店社交账号的20秒横屏介绍，允许静音观看；不是维修教程。
creativeDirection.proposition: 不止修好车，也认真对待来取车的人。
creativeDirection.intendedResponse: 观众愿意把小店与细致、可靠的日常服务联系起来；这是传播意图，尚未测试。

options.title: 手艺的可靠
options.promise: 用机械细节与操作过程证明技术认真。
options.tradeoff: 需要准确维修工艺和更长因果链，现有旧书案例已提示机械结构风险；不适合在20秒里压成神修。

options.title: 日常被照应
options.promise: 让额外照料和稳妥交接成为安心的可见理由。
options.tradeoff: 画面较朴素，需确保双方注意与回应清楚，否则只像普通交车。

options.title: 迅速重新出发
options.promise: 用快切、骑行和动感表达恢复效率。
options.tradeoff: 容易变成速度广告，增加骑行物理与路面风险，也弱化人与人的照应。

creativeDirection.selectionReason: 目标是让人记住小店认真照应人的服务关系。旧书交还关系在一次实片中可读，陶器又提醒我们动作状态比氛围词更需要明确。因此选择细小照料与支撑交接，而不是堆机械细节或炫技运镜。
successSignals: 不听声音，也能看出修车人先注意到来人、再提供照料。
座垫擦拭与交接的接触位置清楚，车辆始终有支撑。
最后是取回车辆后继续行动，不能突然变成站着发呆或独处。
另请观看者描述感受，检验是否读到认真照应，而非预先填写“治愈成功”。
creativeDirection.misreadRisk: 没有疲惫处境和主动回应，可能只读成常规交车；表情或配乐用力过度，又可能变成苦情救赎。

situation.who: 一位疲惫但自主的通勤者，与认真做事的社区修车人。
situation.whereWhen: 雨停后的傍晚，社区修车摊门内外相连；自行车已修好，停在门内。
situation.startingState: 通勤者按约来取车，站在门边；车已修好但座垫还留少量水痕，修车人正在车旁。
situation.motivation: 来人想平稳结束工作日并回家；修车人希望交出一辆可以舒服接手的车。
situation.trigger: 修车人抬眼注意到来人，选择先擦干座垫，再把车扶到可接的位置。
situation.outcome: 接车者接稳后，修车人才松手；接车者自己推车离开，生活继续。

causalChain.change: 独自等待变成被明确注意到。

causalChain.change: 有水痕的座垫变成可接手的干净表面。
causalChain.meaning: 多做一点小事，给关心一个可见落点；不是瞬间修车。

causalChain.meaning: 安心不是留在原地，而是能够从容继续。

shots.title: 被注意到

emotionalBeat.visibleCause: 来人站在门边停住；修车人抬眼并轻点头。
emotionalBeat.why: 让后续照料回应一个具体来人，气氛才有事件依据。
emotionalBeat.alternativeReading: 点头太弱会像偶然对视；垂头太重会像苦情。

direction.zh: 用克制的等待和明确的抬眼回应建立关系，不演悲伤或感激。
direction.en: Establish a relationship through restrained waiting and a clear acknowledging look, without sadness or grateful overacting.

before.zh: 接车者已站在门口近侧，修车人在车的远侧扶住车把立管，车已修好、两轮落地。
before.en: The commuter is already waiting at the near side of the doorway. The mechanic steadies the handlebar stem from the far side; the repaired bicycle rests on both wheels.

performance.zh: 接车者轻放松肩部、抬眼；修车人看向来人，轻点头一次，手仍扶车。
performance.en: The commuter relaxes their shoulders slightly and looks up. The mechanic looks toward them and gives one small nod while keeping the bicycle supported.

after.zh: 两人都不走动，修车人回看座垫，准备照料。
after.en: Both remain in place; the mechanic glances back toward the saddle, preparing to attend to it.

relations.zh: 车位于两人之间且不遮视线，修车人手与车把立管连续接触，另一人尚未接车。
relations.en: The bicycle stands between them without blocking their sightline. The mechanic maintains contact with the stem; the commuter has not taken the bicycle yet.

camera.zh: 固定斜侧双人全中景，无推拉摇移。
camera.en: Locked oblique medium-wide two-shot, without camera movement or zoom.

composition.zh: 能同时看清双方上身、目光和同一车体的两轮落地；门外方向留在右侧。
composition.en: Keep both upper bodies, exchanged looks and both grounded wheels readable; the exit remains screen right.

lighting.zh: 雨后阴天自然光，肤色与店内暗部清楚，不用光束替代情境。
lighting.en: Natural overcast light after rain, readable skin and interior shadows, without expressive light beams.

timing.zh: 前两秒建立等待，约2至3秒抬眼回应，余下时间让观众读清双方。
timing.en: Establish waiting over two seconds, exchange the look around seconds two to three, then allow time to read both people.

sound.zh: 计划为远处城市底噪和衣料声，无对白、旁白或配乐；静音也应读懂回应。
sound.en: Plan distant street ambience and fabric sounds, with no speech, narration or music; the acknowledgment should read when muted.

references.retain: 两人在同一画面的关系
references.adapt: 扩展到车与落地支撑，不复制对坐紧张

shots.referencePlan: 需准备两人／店面身份图与双人空间构图；尚未提供。不能把身份图当成已经点头的动作证据。

transition.zh: 视线落向座垫后硬切同一座垫细节。
transition.en: Cut straight to the same saddle detail after the glance toward it.

action: 车只有一辆、两轮接地，修车人持续扶住车。
确认点头对象是来人而不是画外第三人。
expression: 静音看能否读到等待被回应，而非只有两个人站着。
克制表现疲惫，不以压暗脸部代替情境。

shots.title: 多做一点

emotionalBeat.intent: 让认真照应有明确可见的动作。
emotionalBeat.visibleCause: 一只手扶车，另一只手用布沿有水痕的座垫轻擦一次。
emotionalBeat.why: 额外的小照料比抽象的“温暖”更具体，也给下一镜交接一个准备过程。
emotionalBeat.alternativeReading: 可能被读成普通清洁；需保留前镜来人和后镜接车的因果。

direction.zh: 关注布与座垫的真实接触，表现小事被认真做完，不拍机械奇迹。
direction.en: Attend to real cloth-to-saddle contact, showing a small task completed with care rather than a mechanical miracle.

before.zh: 同一黑座垫表面有少量水痕，车已修好且直立，修车人左手扶住车把立管。
before.en: The same black saddle has a small surface water mark. The already-repaired bicycle is upright and the mechanic steadies its handlebar stem with the left hand.

performance.zh: 修车人右手用一块浅灰布沿座垫表面从后向前擦过一次，布贴着表面，再提起离开。
performance.en: The mechanic makes one rear-to-front pass over the saddle with a light-gray cloth in the right hand, maintaining surface contact before lifting it away.

after.zh: 水痕减少，布离开座垫，车体仍由左手支撑；座垫和座杆不转动。
after.en: The water mark is reduced, the cloth leaves the saddle, and the bicycle remains supported by the left hand. The saddle and seatpost do not rotate.

relations.zh: 保留座垫、固定座杆与一段车架作为结构依据。布只接触表面，不穿透、不让座垫整体变形；镜外左手支撑须在参考构图和下一镜核对。
relations.en: Retain the saddle, fixed seatpost and part of the frame as structural cues. The cloth touches the surface without penetration or reshaping the saddle; offscreen left-hand support must be established in reference framing and checked in the following shot.

camera.zh: 固定的局部插入镜头，普通近景，不要求极端微距或转移焦点。
camera.en: Locked insert detail at a normal close distance, without extreme macro or a focus pull.

composition.zh: 座垫表面和布接触区清楚；保留座杆，不只拍失去支撑关系的材质纹理。
composition.en: Keep the saddle surface and cloth contact sharp; include the seatpost rather than showing unsupported texture alone.

lighting.zh: 延续前镜阴天傍晚光，水痕可辨但不夸张发亮。
lighting.en: Continue the overcast evening light; make the water mark readable without exaggerated shine.

timing.zh: 前一秒保持，约1至3秒擦一次并提布，3至5秒保留完成状态。
timing.en: Hold for one second, make one wiping pass and lift the cloth around seconds one to three, then retain the completed state through second five.

sound.zh: 计划轻微布料摩擦与持续街道底噪，不用音乐替擦拭制造情绪。
sound.en: Plan soft cloth friction and continuous street ambience, without music supplying the emotional meaning.

references.retain: 切近推动事件的具体物件
references.adapt: 只用技巧定义；原信封提示词疑似错配，不采用

shots.referencePlan: 需同一车身份图及座垫／座杆专用近景参考；车扶稳的支撑角色另标明，尚未生成。

transition.zh: 布提起后硬切交车双人机位，车头朝向与上一镜一致。
transition.en: Cut to the handover two-shot after the cloth lifts, preserving the bicycle direction.

action: 擦拭只作用于座垫表面，座杆与车架稳定。
只有一次接触路径，不反复刷、不让布穿透。
expression: 细节需在前后情境中读成照料，不把擦座垫宣称为修好了车。
擦完后确有可读完成状态。

shots.title: 接稳，再松手

emotionalBeat.intent: 通过稳定交接和轻微回应表达安心。
emotionalBeat.visibleCause: 接车者先握车把并扶座垫，修车人才放开，接车者轻点头。
emotionalBeat.why: 照应让人接回自己的行动；支撑顺序同时是内容逻辑与关系表达。
emotionalBeat.alternativeReading: 交接过快可能像递物流水线；夸张鞠躬会变成救赎。

direction.zh: 让支撑转移清楚，接车者自己稳住车辆，回应克制、平等。
direction.en: Make the support transfer readable. The commuter steadies the bicycle independently, with a restrained response between equals.

before.zh: 同一车在门口静止、两轮落地，修车人远侧左手扶车把立管；接车者站在近侧。
before.en: The same bicycle is stationary at the doorway on both wheels. The mechanic on its far side holds the stem with the left hand; the commuter stands on the near side.

performance.zh: 接车者右手握近侧车把握套、左手轻扶座垫。两人共同扶稳约一秒后，修车人左手离开车把立管，接车者轻点头一次。
performance.en: The commuter places the right hand on the near handlebar grip and the left on the saddle. After both steady the bicycle together for about one second, the mechanic releases the stem and the commuter gives one small nod.

after.zh: 接车者独自扶稳车，双方仍站着，尚未迈步；车轮位置不变。
after.en: The commuter alone supports the bicycle. Both people remain standing without stepping yet, and the wheel positions are unchanged.

relations.zh: 固定同一车把、座垫、车轮与地面；接车者双脚落地。先接触再释放，不交换车把左右，不让车身失去支撑。
relations.en: Keep the same handlebar, saddle, wheels and ground relationships. The commuter has both feet planted. Contact precedes release, with no swapped handlebar sides or unsupported frame.

camera.zh: 固定斜侧双人宽景，和第一镜保持同一侧观察，不越轴。
camera.en: Locked oblique wide two-shot from the same side as the opening, without crossing the action axis.

composition.zh: 同时保留两人上身、握持和轮胎接地；交接区不被前景遮住。
composition.en: Include both upper bodies, hand contacts and tire-to-ground contact, without foreground occlusion of the exchange.

lighting.zh: 同一阴天傍晚光，无突然金色光束或亮度跳变。
lighting.en: Maintain the same overcast evening light without sudden golden beams or exposure jumps.

timing.zh: 约0至2秒建立接触，2至3秒共同扶稳，3至4秒修车人松手并回应，最后一秒接稳保持。
timing.en: Establish contacts around seconds zero to two, share support around seconds two to three, release and acknowledge around seconds three to four, then hold the stable state for the final second.

sound.zh: 计划轻微握持和衣料声，保留同一街道空间，不加感激对白。
sound.en: Plan quiet contact and clothing sounds in the same street ambience, without grateful dialogue.

references.purpose: 同时看交接双方与支撑变化
references.adapt: 宽到看清车轮；不是照抄书的共同托举

shots.referencePlan: 需要明确近远两侧人物、车头与握持点的交接起止图，另与第一镜身份对齐；未提供。

transition.zh: 接车者扶稳后切后方机位；下一镜从同一静止握持开始再起步。
transition.en: Cut behind the commuter after independent support is established. Begin the next shot from that same stationary grip before stepping.

action: 接车者握住近侧握套并扶座垫后，修车人才松手。
比较中间状态而非只看首尾，车体不可悬空或跳位。
expression: 共同扶稳的停顿和轻点头都应可读。
另问观众是否读到照应，不预设安心已经传达。

shots.title: 从容继续

emotionalBeat.intent: 让被照应落实为继续自己的路。
emotionalBeat.visibleCause: 接车者承接握持状态，推同一辆车走出，修车人留在店内。
emotionalBeat.why: 结尾的行动能力属于接车者；前面的照料有了实际后果。
emotionalBeat.alternativeReading: 只有背影可能显孤独，因此片尾不靠孤立长空镜，保留前面交接因果。

direction.zh: 跟随人的自主前行，平稳而非追赶；这里的继续走是目标，不要求停在门口。
direction.en: Follow the commuter resuming their own movement, steadily rather than in pursuit. Continued walking is intentional here, not a pause at the doorway.

before.zh: 接车者站在车的近侧，双脚已落地，右手握近侧车把、左手扶座垫，修车人已松手。
before.en: The commuter stands beside the near side of the bicycle with both feet planted, right hand on the near grip and left hand on the saddle. The mechanic has already released it.

performance.zh: 接车者先自然迈步，再缓慢推车沿右前方人行道离开；保持在车旁，不跨坐，车轮沿地面随位移滚动。
performance.en: The commuter starts a natural step, then slowly walks the bicycle along the pavement toward front right, remaining beside it without mounting. The wheels roll on the ground with its travel.

after.zh: 接车者与车持续向前，修车人留在后方摊位；不突然转身或额外挥手。
after.en: The commuter and bicycle continue forward while the mechanic stays at the stall behind, without a sudden turn or extra wave.

relations.zh: 手与车把、座垫持续接触，车与人同速前进，车头承接前镜朝向。腿和车轮各自运动，不让整车平移滑行。
relations.en: Maintain hand contact with the grip and saddle. The person and bicycle advance together in the established direction; legs step and wheels roll rather than the whole bicycle sliding.

camera.zh: 摄影机在人物后方略偏近侧，平稳跟随向前；固定焦距，不变焦、环绕或后拉。
camera.en: Follow smoothly from behind and slightly toward the near side at a fixed focal length, without zooming, orbiting or dollying backward.

composition.zh: 保留接车者上身、推车握持和轮胎接地，起始还能辨认后方摊位，之后自然离开背景。
composition.en: Retain the commuter upper body, pushing contacts and grounded tires. The stall is initially readable behind and naturally recedes.

lighting.zh: 延续同一天的阴天光，不因离开就突然变成晴天或夕阳。
lighting.en: Continue the same overcast daylight without a sudden sun or sunset transformation.

timing.zh: 前约0.5秒承接站稳状态，随后正常速度起步并持续前行到结束；不要求最后两秒静止。
timing.en: Continue the planted start for roughly half a second, then begin walking at normal speed and keep moving through the end, without a two-second still hold.

sound.zh: 计划脚步、轮胎滚动与连续街道底噪；声画需实际制作后单独检查。
sound.en: Plan footsteps, rolling tires and continuous street ambience; check audio content and synchronization separately after production.

references.purpose: 把继续前行作为结尾经历
references.retain: 人物前行、相机后方同速跟随
references.adapt: 推车而非端杯，不要求停步停镜

shots.referencePlan: 需承接第三镜握持的后方起始构图与出门方向参考；不是任意骑车素材，尚未提供。

transition.zh: 在继续前行时结束，必要时后期短收声，不用定格伪造停留；片名另在后期处理。
transition.en: End during continued travel, with a short audio tail in post if needed. Do not fabricate a pause with a freeze frame; handle titles separately in post.

action: 先承接已接稳状态再起步，修车人不重新扶车。
检查脚步、车轮转动与位移，不以背景变动冒充跟拍。
expression: 最后应读作从容继续，不是追逐或悲伤离开。
本镜持续走符合目标，不能机械套用陶器末镜停住的标准。
